annotations.title: Ask to be paid (IFSO request link)

description: Creates a payment request: someone asks to be paid an amount of USDG, USDe or ETH, and gets a link to share. The payer opens the link and funds an if-so payment to them. An optional note (at most 140 characters) and how many days the link stays open (1 to 30, default 7). Nothing moves until the payer funds it.

amount.description: Amount in whole units of the asset, e.g. "20" or "0.015".

asset.description: The asset: USDG, USDe or ETH on Robinhood Chain.

days.description: How long the link stays open.

note.description: What it is for, in plain text.

recipient.description: The wallet that asks to be paid.

name: ifso_create_request
